findings: CVE-2026-73561 is PUBLISHED at cveawg.mitre.org and describes the unauthenticated get-client-id RPC waiter leak as fixed in 0.2.16; GHSA-g5vv-q72c-7j78 is not withdrawn.

Source-to-sink is real: default unauthenticated WebSocket connection always issues rpc.send('get-client-id'), queues RPC.requests, and starts a reply-only setInterval; socket close does not cancel the waiter.

BIC is f5d03cac30baa3f9d066095962e08df3c61112ce versus parent d5cb93d5d6f5b7d8e77c998cf74125383d95232b, whose library RPC and client-id path lack the waiter; later TypeScript conversion 990461ee58370b5f1cc2c2c2f1efd827a08cecbd is a carrier, not the introducer.
Direct fix is 931576db3cdbf4f1583bd2c3c8759c4f4e032ab3; v0.2.16 tag commit 67260d2a1407a77f082f02dc9e1f0891222c306d is the version-bump release carrier.
BIC authorship is human-only (Paul Jensen, 2020-10-12, no AI/bot trailers), so the closed verdict is NOT_AI.
